title: continuing to work on Astromino - roguelite Tetris 99%+ coded with Claude Code
author: BenMakesGames
selftext:
I'm sure everyone's already got their own collection of Claude Skills they like, but here's mine, in case you're interested: [https://github.com/BenMakesGames/my-claude-skills](https://github.com/BenMakesGames/my-claude-skills)

my general flow is nothing radical:

1. brainstorm features, producing design docs
2. write tickets from design docs
3. implement tickets, documenting any trouble spots encountered
4. repeat, with occasional sessions to identify & address recurring trouble spots

Astromino screenshots (and a trailer made by a friend) are on the Steam store page: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4644350/Astromino/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4644350/Astromino/) ;)
